Key objective findings include normal CBC, CMP, and a skin biopsy showing **epidermal necrosis and detachment**, highly suggestive of a severe cutaneous adverse reaction (SCAR), such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS), toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), or drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS).
